name: Estimate Desk
office_task: When a price request from our website form is logged as a job, draft the estimate from our own price list, or park it with a reason, and tell me it is ready for me to send.
systems_of_record: Xero (Items as the price list, Quotes)

emits.write: A draft quote on the job the form request was logged as, one line per unit of each service asked for, every line carrying its catalogue id and its rate as read from the price list at draft time, ex GST. The owner is alerted that it is ready; this node has no way to send it to the customer.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}, ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked estimate as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list, the services that did price with their catalogue ids, the ones that did not, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for estimates.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.

port_of.original_name: Send instant price quotes from forms with Data Tables, Telegram and Gmail
